from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Full monochrome lines are separators. The sections between them are cells.
    row_sep = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1]
    col_sep = [c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Only treat a line as a divider if it is a color other than the background.
    bg = 3
    row_sep = [r for r in row_sep if g[r][0] != bg]
    col_sep = [c for c in col_sep if g[0][c] != bg]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_sep + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_sep + [w]
    row_cells = [(row_bounds[i]+1, row_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1)]
    col_cells = [(col_bounds[i]+1, col_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1)]
    # Pick the cell with the most non-background content as the source pattern.
    cells = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_cells):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_cells):
            cells.append((sum(g[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)), ri, ci, r0, r1, c0, c1))
    _, sri, sci, sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = max(cells)
    template = [g[r][sc0:sc1] for r in range(sr0, sr1)]
    # Repeat the source cell pattern in every cell of the same partition.
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_cells):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_cells):
            if (ri, ci) == (sri, sci):
                continue
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    g[r][c] = template[(r-r0) % len(template)][(c-c0) % len(template[0])]
    return g
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = 3
    row_sep = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1 and g[r][0] != bg]
    col_sep = [c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][c] != bg]
    # A cell ends at the first full divider; subsequent cells repeat after its one-line gap.
    cell_h = row_sep[0] if row_sep else h
    cell_w = col_sep[0] if col_sep else w
    pitch_h = cell_h + (1 if row_sep else 0)
    pitch_w = cell_w + (1 if col_sep else 0)
    row_starts = list(range(0, h, pitch_h))
    col_starts = list(range(0, w, pitch_w))
    # Locate the one populated cell; its pattern is copied to each blank cell.
    scores = [(sum(g[r][c] != bg for r in range(rs, min(rs+cell_h,h)) for c in range(cs,min(cs+cell_w,w))), rs, cs)
              for rs in row_starts for cs in col_starts]
    _, sr, sc = max(scores)
    th = min(cell_h, h-sr)
    tw = min(cell_w, w-sc)
    template = [g[sr+i][sc:sc+tw] for i in range(th)]
    for rs in row_starts:
        for cs in col_starts:
            if (rs, cs) == (sr, sc):
                continue
            for i in range(min(cell_h, h-rs)):
                for j in range(min(cell_w, w-cs)):
                    g[rs+i][cs+j] = template[i % th][j % tw]
    return g
'''
